Over a prolonged period, my sister repeatedly raised serious symptoms and concerns. These were not acted on with the urgency they warranted. Opportunities for earlier investigation, referral, and escalation were missed. By the time her cancer was finally diagnosed, it had progressed to an advanced, incurable stage.

In my view, this represents a serious failure of care, communication, and clinical judgement. The emotional devastation this has caused our family is immeasurable, and the consequences for my sister’s health are life-changing.

Patients rely on their GP practice to listen, investigate properly, and advocate for them when something is clearly wrong. That did not happen here.

I sincerely hope this practice reflects on what went wrong and makes changes so that no other family has to experience the same avoidable harm.",null,[0,140]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xZM2NVSkZVSEYxYzIxVVExbGhZbEIxVEc5clIxRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x86c0086a761ed273!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOlY3cUJFUHF1c21UQ1lhYlB1TG9rR1E%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xZM2NVSkZVSEYxYzIxVVExbGhZbEIxVEc5clIxRRAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiz3LzA2bGTAxWNO3sEHahsGUkQoykIBygB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwiz3LzA2bGTAxWNO3sEHahsGUkQ0pMFCAUoAQ"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBaHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMDh5WjA1T1ExOWZSV2hEYlVnMFNHWnlXRk01ZWpscFRuUkRkMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpTV1VOWk4yRkJNREJKV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tOWGJISnNSMUZGTUVZM2FWWTFUMFkwYjI1bWFVRRAB",["0x0:0x86c0086a761ed273",null,1770037917220870,1770037917220870,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/116364271213353270015/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Victoria Rodwell","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWVZrOdPJWBVRe_S3UsUK7DP9VTzPVC7mg_ECsDavZAcwa4Abg=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/116364271213353270015?hl=en"],"116364271213353270015",null,6,0,null,[0,3,1],0,["6 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwiz3LzA2bGTAxWNO3sEHahsGUkQ7LoGCAkoAA"]]]],null,"a month ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["If I could give this doctors surgery -10000 I would. I've needed help with an issue returning after many years. That has meant two appointments with Mrs Cooper the relevant nurse, the second of those today. Both times she has been very helpful indeed, carefully listening to my concerns and addressing them. Plus leaving me the option of a further appointment if I need that. Nursing at its very best, thank you so much Mrs Cooper and West Malling Group Practice. I'm only sorry I can't give another five stars. Now back to my original review: Yesterday I needed to get a non-regular prescription and, not realising that Anima had a 'message the doctor' facility, I dropped a note into the Leybourne Surgery.  Within minutes I was getting calls and texts from Leyboune, to very nicely tell me that the request had been put on Anima for me.
